scope: factorization/regularity audit only; no Ozuch coefficient values are computed

product_resolvent_algebra.symbolic_cross_multiplication_difference: -C*kappa - C*x - C*y + a*b + a*y + b*x + x*y
product_resolvent_algebra.conclusion: A literal product of two one-factor Green functions is not the inverse of a sum-type product Einstein operator. Factor geometry separates variables, but inversion gives additive denominators.
product_resolvent_algebra.legitimate_one_factor_reduction: If one factor is first projected to a single eigenvalue lambda_fixed, the remaining factor solves a massive S2 Green problem with shift lambda_fixed+algebraic_shift.

pole_second_jet_infinite_l_check.endpoint_parity: P_l''(-1)=(-1)^l P_l''(1); associated/spin bases may add fixed frame signs
pole_second_jet_infinite_l_check.conclusion: The T2 character selection |m|<=2 does not truncate l; a |m|=2 pole second-jet channel contains every l>=2.

adjacent_example_pNN_to_pNS.regularity: regular as a 4D inter-node Green evaluation; no receiver singular subtraction
adjacent_example_pNN_to_pNS.mode_sign_schematic: (-1)^{l2} from the antipodal factor; no alternation from the coincident factor
adjacent_example_pNN_to_pNS.warning: Do not multiply a singular one-factor Green at N=N by an antipodal factor Green; the inverse denominator is additive and the full 4D kernel is smooth off the product diagonal.

diagonal_example_pNN_to_pSS.regularity: regular in both factors and in the full 4D product
diagonal_example_pNN_to_pSS.use_as_calibration: cleanest first case; diagonal r=2 also has the larger D8 stabilizer and the working spin-row identification

ozuch_source_anchors.source_singularity: Ozuch Prop. 2.10 lines 608-612: bar h^4 is asymptotic to H^4+H_2^4 at the specified singular point and is solved with kernel/obstruction projections.
ozuch_source_anchors.multi_node_regular_expansion: Ozuch lines 903-905: the sum over i' != i has expansion H_0(i)+H_2(i)+O(d(i,.)^4) at another singular point, confirming regular inter-node second-jet extraction.
ozuch_source_anchors.obstruction_equations: Ozuch lines 770-807: exact nearby Einstein metrics force t_j lambda_k^j + t_j^2 mu_k^j = O(t_max^(5/2)).

completion_criterion.object: Ozuch mixed-row second-obstruction coefficients on O=(S2xS2)/Z2
must_output: For each independent pattern class r=1~r=3, adjacent r=2, diagonal r=2: coefficient maps for every node and every zeta in ker(R_±) in a fixed basis, including D8 transport conventions.
Inter-node contribution computed from the full product P-Green/resolvent or an equivalent heat-kernel/massive-resolvent formula, not from a naive product of two massless S2 Green functions.
No singular subtraction at receiver nodes j != i; singular asymptotic and source renormalization handled only at the source/self node, plus global kernel projection.
The four non-TT scalar full-gauged kernel directions are explicitly sliced by L2 orthogonality or included as Ozuch v_l variables/projections.
r=1 and r=3 complement/reflection systems agree; both balanced classes obey their self-conjugacy constraints; diagonal r=2 satisfies its larger stabilizer checks.
If closed forms are not obtained, a certified tail bound for the remaining alternating/resolvent series is part of the output; a raw truncated spectral sum is not enough.
completion_criterion.scientific_role: diagnostic for local nearby-orbifold desingularization/tower-rigidity on the product geometry, not a proof/refutation of P4+ or Yau-26
